subject: OrchidHealth onboarding — privacy package, subprocessor list, and PO info
messages:
From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@orchidhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Redwood onboarding & PO requirements

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here at OrchidHealth asked me to kick off the paperwork so we can get your service live for our clinical triage product. Per our conversation, here are the items they asked for up front so we can create a PO and move to a signed agreement: 

- Signed DPA (we can countersign or use your template) — procurement prefers signed PDFs.
- Current SOC 2 Type II report or a secure link to the auditor artifact.
- Current subprocessor roster and a short note on any subprocessors that access customer data in production.
- Vendor billing info (W‑9 / tax id for US companies, and e‑invoice address).

I attached a draft DPA (OrchidHealth_DPA_proposal.docx) for your legal team's review. Our procurement email is procurement@orchidhealth.com if you want to loop them in directly for PO terms.

Could you confirm timeline? We are hoping to have a PO in place by next Thursday (8/6).

Thanks—looking forward to getting this moving.

—Sarah
Sarah Jones
Head of Partnerships, OrchidHealth
sarah.jones@orchidhealth.com
+1 (415) 555‑0182

Attachment: OrchidHealth_DPA_proposal.docx (docx)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Redwood onboarding & PO requirements

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear list. We can meet the timeline but need the following to complete Redwood's procurement intake: 

1) Signed DPA PDF (we can countersign your doc if it matches our minimal edits) — if you want faster turnaround, send via DocuSign.
2) SOC 2: we require either the full Type II report or a secure read‑only link from your auditor host. Redacted versions are fine so long as auditor and timestamp are visible.
3) Subprocessor list: include name, role, and whether they have access to production customer data or logs. A CSV is easiest for our vendor portal.
4) Billing details: legal business name, tax id (W‑9), billing email for invoices, and preferred PO contact.

I'll loop in Laura from Procurement for PO setup and Ben on the commercial side. If possible, send the signed DPA and subprocessor CSV today so Laura can start the PO route.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai
(415) 555‑0222

Hi Ava / Laura / Ben —

Thanks — attached are the items your procurement team requested: 

- OrchidHealth_DPA_signed.pdf (signed by OrchidHealth counsel). We used our standard DPA and included the standard security annex.
- OrchidHealth_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (link to auditor storage below) — we are comfortable sharing a redacted copy for procurement.
- orchid_subprocessors_v1.csv (columns: vendor_name, purpose, access_description, region, contact) — highlighted rows indicate vendors with access to customer data.
- Billing details: OrchidHealth, Inc.; EIN 12‑3456789; billing@orchidhealth.com; remit address: 120 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94107.

Secure link to SOC 2 (read‑only): https://storage.orchidhealth.com/reports/OrchidHealth_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf
DocuSign envelope for DPA: https://app.docusign.com/Envelope/XYZ12345

Let us know if Redwood needs a countersignature on a different DPA or any additional certs. We included a short notes column in the CSV for subprocessors that handle PHI.

Best,
Sarah

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for sending everything so quickly, this is perfect. I started the PO in our system and we have generated PO-006432 (attached). Next steps on our side: 

- Legal will take a quick look at the DPA; if there are any non‑material comments I'll route via DocuSign for countersignature.
- Procurement has validated the SOC 2 link and confirmed the auditor and date are visible — acceptable for PO creation.
- Our vendor intake accepted the CSV; we flagged three subprocessors that require encryption attestation (noted in the intake). Could Orchid confirm the encryption-in-transit/at-rest statements for those three vendors (a one‑line confirmation email is fine).

Please send the billing contact for invoices and we will route the PO to your procurement address: billing@orchidhealth.com. If everything looks good we expect to issue the first live invoice after the PO is acknowledged by your team.

Attached: PO-006432-redwood.pdf

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
